description:
The Gray square-QAM preset takes the I-axis label from the first $m/2$ label bits. `@/citation/Etsi2015` Table 14 takes I from the even-indexed and Q from the odd-indexed cell-word bits, so preset labels agree with the standard for orders 2 and 4 only.

## Background

`crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/presets.rs` (the `gray_qam` preset Rustdoc states the difference); `crates/gf2-coding/examples/modem_gray_qam_preset.rs:42` claims conformance without the qualification. `@/inv/standards-vector-conformance` applies.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A test reproduces the reported behavior at the cited location, or a record shows the report does not hold and the issue is rejected with that evidence.
- [hard] REQ-02: The DVB-T2 constellation presets map cell words as Table 14 specifies for every supported order, checked against an external vector source, or the generic preset carries no standards-conformance claim in Rustdoc and examples.
title: Gray-QAM preset labels differ from EN 302 755 Table 14 above order 4
